Humans enter the pact of Elves and Dwarves called the Inheritor’s Pact, and share the secrets of stories and emotion with the elder races of Elves and Dwarves. Humans are recognized for their ability to lead and learn, and become the de-facto masters of the pact, replacing the elves as the world's protectors and loosening the Elven moral code on the world.
